name: cn.dianyinhuoban.hm.mvp.ScanActivity
description: The Dianyin Guanjia Hongmeng Edition (电银管家泓盟版) SDK from holderman has a screen that opens the camera to read a QR code, also lets users choose a code image from the gallery, and returns the decoded result to the screen that requested it.
disableEffect: QR scanning and any app flow that needs its returned code will stop working.
